transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our routine material-handling huddle started. We've got three moves planned for tomorrow — one clinic cold-chain pallet, one generator skid, and one communications shelter crate — all going from the receiving yard to their assigned storage areas. Before I publish the final equipment assignment, I need to confirm a few things from each of you. First, are there any receiving updates or changes to the load plan? Second, I need to confirm the status of our available equipment: the F-2 electric forklift, the F-1 diesel forklift, and the 5-ton mobile crane. Are all three operational and ready for the workday? Once I have your inputs, I'll finalize the equipment assignments and safety controls for each move.

transcript.text: Major, I need to flag a receiving update before we finalize assignments.
